role_evidence.quote: In this arm, subjects that do not have a clinical indication for surgical resection of the recurrent tumor will start TTFields therapy 5-7 days prior to starting oral niraparib (a PARP inhibitor).

source_quote.quote: To correlate PARP expression by pathology testing with uptake of \[18F\]FTT in surgical subjects.
Correlate [18F]FTT uptake measures with Homologous recombination deficiency (HRD) status or other markers of "BRCAness".

coder_notes: Imaging-only companion study (Early Phase 1). Only registered intervention is the PET tracer 18F-FluorThanatrace (diagnostic). Niraparib (and TTFields) are given in the companion treatment trial IRB 832694, not as an intervention of this record; niraparib listed as soc_backbone (received by all participants via the companion trial) for transparency. No candidate here. Pre/post-PARPi FTT uptake could be read as PARP target engagement of niraparib, but niraparib is not a candidate in this record, so target_engagement_planned coded no. Niraparib: Surgical cohort initiates it post-operatively; optional post-PARPi scan in Cohort A only.
